description: High-frequency Discord coding prompts for routing, queue admission, and workflow creation pressure. Keep tasks lightweight so the bottleneck reflects intake and queueing more than deep implementation.

scenarios.message: /coder: Build a fast promo landing page with hero, benefits, CTA, and FAQ section.
/coder: Build a compact product landing page with headline, feature grid, audience section, and contact CTA.
/coder: Build a personal portfolio page with projects, bio, skills, and contact links.
/coder: Build a SaaS pricing page with plan cards, comparison table, and FAQ.
/coder: Build a small CSV to JSON conversion script with clear CLI usage and validation.
/coder: Build a small file rename helper that applies a prefix and timestamp to files in a folder.
/coder: Build a small manifest generator that scans a folder and writes manifest.json with file sizes.
/coder: Build a FAQ microsite with categories, search box, and collapsible answers.
/coder: Build a lightweight todo web app with add, edit, and complete actions.
/coder: Build a small report generator that reads JSON input and writes a markdown summary.
